page_title: HAM 2-1 STU | Hamburger SV v Stuttgart 30/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' 2 - 1 Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) collects a sweet pass and fires a low shot into the bottom left corner. What a goal!
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
88' Substitution. Ransford Konigsdorffer is replaced by Guilherme Ramos (Hamburger).
87' Here is a change. Badredine Bouanani is going off and Sebastian Hoeness gives the last tactical orders to Lazar Jovanovic (VfB Stuttgart).
87' Today's match ends for Ramon Hendriks who will be replaced by Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart).
87' Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
85' Stuttgart take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
82' The attendance is 57000.
81' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) was probably a bit loose with his words to Soren Storks, who decides to show him a yellow.
81' Alexander Rossing-Lelesiit (Hamburger) is given a yellow card by Soren Storks and because it's his second one today, the game is over for him.
80' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) gets inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but smashes his shot just inches past the right post. He should have scored!
79' Alexander Rossing-Lelesiit (Hamburger) takes a short corner kick.
79' The ball is cleared after Jordan Torunarigha (Hamburger) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Hamburger SV force their opponents to concede a corner.
76' Hamburger SV can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
74' Chema Andres (VfB Stuttgart) is punished with the yellow card.
73' Miro Muheim (Hamburger) is about to take a corner kick.
72' A pass into the penalty area from Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) is intercepted by the defence. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Hamburger SV.
71' Alexander Rossing-Lelesiit (Hamburger) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
68' Substitution. Fabio Balde (Hamburger) has come on for Rayan Philippe.
67' Merlin Polzin decides to make a substitution. William Mikelbrencis will be replaced by Giorgi Gocholeishvili (Hamburger).
67' That will be all from Albert Sambi Lokonga who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Fabio Vieira (Hamburger).
66' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
65' A yellow-coloured card is received by Alexander Rossing-Lelesiit (Hamburger).
65' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Miro Muheim (Hamburger). Soren Storks saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
61' The corner kick from Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
60' Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence. Stuttgart get a corner.
58' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) will replace Nikolas Nartey.
54' 1 - 1 Goal! Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the top left corner. It's 1:1.
49' The corner is swung in but Stuttgart can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
46' Sebastian Hoeness makes a half-time substitution. Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) comes on in place of Pascal Stenzel.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
40' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) has picked up an injury and is replaced by Deniz Undav.
38' Stuttgart control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
33' Merlin Polzin is forced to make a change. Robert Glatzel is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger).
31' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Nikolas Nartey (VfB Stuttgart) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
23' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Pascal Stenzel (VfB Stuttgart) was quite harsh and Soren Storks didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
20' Stuttgart string together a series of short passes.

17' 1 - 0 Goal! Alexander Rossing-Lelesiit displays great vision and sends a pass to Robert Glatzel (Hamburger), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom right corner. The score is 1:0.
14' Nicolas Capaldo (Hamburger) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Soren Storks saw the whole situation.
11' Robert Glatzel (Hamburger) smashes the ball against the crossbar! What a chance.

9' Robert Glatzel (Hamburger) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The ball goes out for a corner. Hamburger SV can continue in their attacking effort.
5' The corner from Badredine Bouanani (VfB Stuttgart) is intercepted by the defence.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Stuttgart will kick the game off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Soren Storks.
